changes.comment: Correct discovery evidence to require agent-owned sessions, application state or credentials, preserving Cursor desktop storage. Consumers of detectAgents with built-in recipes, including agent-presence and application setup/detection screens, now report missing when no command, recognized application or agent-owned file exists, including Claude Code with only ~/.claude.json (macOS keychain login and no session yet) and machines populated only by harness hooks, plugins, skills or shared MCP/settings. Command and application evidence is unchanged.
